text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Listen to this, this beautiful 
laughter of mine!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Your voice has completely returned to the 
beautiful tone befitting a "Rose."

The day of the Rose Stakes. Naturally, my 
throat burn from eating too much spicy 
food cleared right up.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
1,800m... Is there anything in particular 
I should keep in mind when running this 
distance?
choice_data_list: Just be careful with your pace.

text_block_list.text:
If I sprint at full speed from start to 
finish, my distance aptitudes will make 
the final stretch brutal...

Looking at it another way, that was the 
only real concern. As long as she 
conserved her stamina and made her move at 
the optimal moment, there wouldn't be any 
problem.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Okay! Make sure not to overdo it early on. 
The pace should be slower compared to a GⅠ 
race, after all...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Today, you're going to be leisurely 
entertained by my potential in the prime 
of autumn!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh, the one over there is... Hehe, it 
seems you really can't take your eyes off 
me.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Watch closely, Dober. Witness the running 
of the one who will become your greatest 
rival in the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Pearl-san... She seems so full of 
confidence...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to see. Just how well the current 
Pearl-san can perform at this distance.

—With Mejiro Dober watching on, the trial 
race leading up to the Shuka Sho begins.
